name: Spain
visa_name: Spain Digital Nomad Visa (Ley de Startups)
tax_notes: Special Beckham Law regime applies: flat 24% tax rate up to €600,000 for up to 5 years.
key_requirements: Non-EEA/EU citizens
Proof of remote work for at least 3 months for companies outside Spain
Clean criminal background check apostilled
Private health insurance valid in Spain
Degree or 3+ years relevant work experience

name: Portugal
tax_notes: Replaced NHR with IFICI program; progressive tax rates otherwise unless qualifying for specific talent schemes.
key_requirements: Remote contract or freelance contracts outside Portugal
Bank balance showing at least 12 months minimum income (~€39,000+)
NIF tax number and Portuguese bank account
1-year lease agreement or accommodation proof
Travel / Private health insurance

name: Thailand
tax_notes: Foreign-sourced income remitted in the same tax year is subject to Thai personal tax; funds remitted in later years or kept offshore generally tax-exempt.
key_requirements: Proof of 500,000 THB in bank account
Employment contract or freelance portfolio as a remote worker
Or enrollment in Muay Thai / Thai cooking / medical treatment
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity

name: Japan
tax_notes: Exempt from local Japanese income taxes under bilateral tax treaties for stays under 6 months.
key_requirements: Citizen of 49 designated visa-waiver countries (US, UK, EU, etc.)
Annual income of 10M JPY (~$68k USD) or higher
Private medical insurance covering up to 10M JPY
Spouse and children can accompany

name: Greece
tax_notes: 50% income tax deduction for up to 7 years if transferring tax residence to Greece.
key_requirements: Proof of €3,500/month stable remote earnings
Clean criminal record
Medical certificate & international health insurance
Rental lease in Greece

name: Croatia
tax_notes: 100% exempt from Croatian income tax on remote work income.
key_requirements: Third-country national (non-EU/EEA)
Bank statements showing 12 months funds (~€30k) or monthly income proof
Must exit for 6 months after 1-year permit before reapplying
Full health insurance & local address registration (OIB)

name: Mexico
tax_notes: Income earned entirely outside Mexico from non-Mexican employers is generally not taxed unless Mexican tax residency is triggered.
key_requirements: Proof of financial solvency (last 6-12 months bank statements)
In-person interview at Mexican consulate outside Mexico
Exchange visa for Canje card at INM within 30 days of arrival

name: Costa Rica
visa_name: Costa Rica Estancia Visa for Remote Workers (Law 10008)
tax_notes: Complete exemption from Costa Rican income tax, import tax on equipment, and duty on vehicles.
key_requirements: Proof of $3,000 USD monthly income over the past 12 months
Medical insurance covering entire stay ($50k coverage min)
Application submitted via Tramite Ya portal

name: United Arab Emirates (Dubai)
visa_name: Dubai Remote Work Visa (Virtual Working Programme)
tax_notes: 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax.
key_requirements: Proof of employment with 1-year contract validity or business ownership
Last month salary slip and 3 months bank statements
Health insurance with UAE coverage

name: Georgia
tax_notes: Individual Entrepreneur Small Business Status offers 1% flat turnover tax up to ~180k USD.
key_requirements: 365-day visa-free entry for US, EU, and many other passports
Simple border run resets the 365-day counter
Health insurance recommended
